meta.name: mem-search
meta.description: Use this when the user asks to search memory, "did we already solve this?", "how did we do X last time?", or wants work from previous sessions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 回溯历史对话,找到之前怎么解决的
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望 AI 记得之前聊过的需求和方案
copy.tagline_en: Search past conversations to recall how you solved it
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work with AI over many sessions and need it to remember earlier context.

howto.what: 这个技能让 Claude 能搜索跨会话的持久记忆。你问起以前怎么做的，它会先搜出相关条目的简短列表，再查看条目前后的上下文，最后只调取选中条目的完整记录来回答。
howto.when: 当用户问“以前解决过吗”“上次是怎么做的”等关于过去会话的问题，或要求翻查以往工作时触发；不用于当前对话。

say.text: 我们上次是怎么修复登录报错的？
say.note: Claude 会搜索相关历史并介绍当时的做法。

say.text: 查一下上周在这个项目里改了什么。
say.note: 按日期范围搜索过去一周的记录。

say.text: 之前我们讨论过数据库迁移吗？
say.note: 会检查过往会话并摘要相关结论。

howto.what_en: This skill lets Claude search its stored cross-session memory. When asked about past work, it first retrieves a short list of matching entries, shows context around them, then fetches full records only for the selected items.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks about prior sessions (e.g., 'did we already solve this?', 'how did we do X last time?') or wants work from previous sessions. Not for the current conversation.

say_en.text: How did we fix the login error last time?
say_en.note: Claude searches memory and describes the past fix.

say_en.text: What did we change in this project last week?
say_en.note: Searches records from the last week by date.

say_en.text: Have we discussed database migration before?
say_en.note: Checks past sessions and summarizes related notes.
